output.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Counts the orders in marts.fct_orders that have status 'cancelled' and an order_date in 2025 (fiscal year = calendar year).
